request.style: English, upbeat folk, bright male vocal with female harmony, acoustic guitars, banjo, fiddle, upright bass, foot-stomp percussion, joyful, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I had it all planned out from the morning to the night
I had a map for every road and a reason for each fight
But the rain came down on the dusty field and the seed began to grow
And it taught me there's a wisdom that I'm never going to know

[Chorus]
For my thoughts are not your thoughts
Nor are your ways my ways, declares the LORD
As the heavens are higher than the earth
So are my ways higher than your ways

[Verse]
Seek the LORD while he may be found
Call on him while he is near
Let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him
And to our God, for he will freely pardon

[Chorus]
For my thoughts are not your thoughts
Nor are your ways my ways, declares the LORD
As the heavens are higher than the earth
So are my ways higher than your ways

[Bridge]
So is my word that goes out from my mouth
It will not return to me empty
You will go out with joy and be led forth in peace

[Outro]
The mountains and hills will break into song before you
And all the trees of the field will clap their hands
